objective: A frozen computation, for the square, triangular and honeycomb boards at g = 2 to 6: the route polygon and the board's graph polygon exactly from the quotient's simple cycles, and again from slopes of breadth-first distances on large tori; whether they are homothetic, and which is rounder.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-10 (exploratory, exact; frozen contract; P1 and H hold): on the square, triangular, honeycomb and kagome boards at g = 2 to 6, the route polygon is the graph polygon scaled by 1/(g d/2) (d the ring degree), so the route reading is the board's graph distance times g d/2 up to a constant; no board read is rounder or less round. Breadth-first distances stay within a constant of the gauge (after the analysis was amended to count the torus's images).
title: Route and graph polygons of three boards
